requests.name: Kıvılcım Ligi
requests.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: standalone volumetric league emblem for GRIDSHARD mobile game, preview only. Image 1 is the exact existing Kıvılcım Ligi glyph identity; preserve its silhouette, topology and main structural elements. Image 2 is ONLY the approved chunky casual/RPG game-art style reference, not an object to include. Subject: six-point angular spark silhouette with alternating pointed rays. Palette: warm golden yellow, amber shaded sides. Create a clean, bold, dimensionally thick stylized 3D icon: broad crisp chamfered facets, deep colored side planes, restrained upper-left highlight and dark indigo contour. Slightly elevated near-front perspective; preserve the glyph's recognizability. Simple uncluttered silhouette readable at 28px, 40px and 96px. Centered with 10% transparent padding and genuine alpha. NO badge, plate, shield, enclosing disk or background behind the symbol. No text, letter, number, rank pips, trophy or extra ornament (unless the stated subject itself is a crown). No decorative sparkles, fog, glow, soft blur, realistic chrome or photographic metal, flat outlined vector, rounded gummy/toy finish, duplicated symbols or sprite sheet. Output ONE isolated physical emblem, not a UI mockup. Preserve the existing identity; do not redesign any other game asset.
